biographical_milestones.historical_context: Inter-community marriage to Feroze Gandhi under active Rahu-Saturn (Saturn ruling 7th House Capricorn).

biographical_milestones.event: Sworn in as Prime Minister of India
biographical_milestones.historical_context: Ascended to Prime Ministership following Lal Bahadur Shastri's sudden demise during Jupiter-Sun (Jupiter 9th Lord of Fortune, Sun 2nd Lord in 5th of Authority).
Declared nationwide state of Emergency during Saturn-Mercury (Saturn 8th Lord of drastic transformation and crisis).
Historic electoral wipeout and arrest during Saturn-Ketu (Ketu in 12th House of fall, loss, and isolation; classical Chhidra Dasha).
Decisive landslide election return to Prime Ministership under Saturn-Venus (Venus in 6th house of Shatru-Jaya / overcoming adversaries).
Assassinated by bodyguards in New Delhi under Saturn-Rahu (Saturn primary 7th Maraka Lord in Lagna, Rahu in 6th house of violence and weapons aspected by Mars).
